placeholder.message: The {{page}} page has no content yet. It is delivered by work order {{ticket}}.

cwd.fallback: The original working directory no longer exists; fell back to the project root.

terminal.resumePickerHint: Session id was not recognized. A picker is open. Choose the conversation in the terminal. The latest one is not resumed automatically.
terminal.promptTooLong: Initial prompt is too long (max {{max}} characters). Longer text will use workbench briefs later.

newWindow.title: New window
newWindow.roleHint: Plain windows get the shared brief only. Manager, planner, worker and reviewer also get their own brief.
newWindow.yoloConfirm: I understand YOLO skips all CLI permission checks and may alter the repo or run arbitrary commands.
newWindow.initialPromptPlaceholder: First message sent to the AI after launch
newWindow.cliMissing: {{cli}} was not found. Install it and make sure it is on PATH.
newWindow.noProfile: No launch profile for this CLI yet. Create one in Settings.
newWindow.routeMissing: Config "{{name}}" has no {{cli}} route, so this window cannot be opened.

configDraft.description: Review every field and how it differs from the current config. Cancel discards the draft. API keys are typed only here and are never given to the AI.
configDraft.apiKeyHint: Type it only in this box. The AI cannot see it and cannot put it in the draft.

permission.windowsNote: On Windows this is CLI policy plus in-app arbitration, not OS-level isolation.
permission.restartHint: A running session must restart/resume for new CLI flags to apply.

role.badgeHint: Click or right-click to set this window's role
role.notAi: The focused window is not an AI window
role.rejected: This window cannot be given that role
role.dropped: The window had exited, so the role note was not written. The next launch injects it

resumeConfirm.title: Start this window?
resumeConfirm.body: Permission is "{{permission}}" and role is "{{role}}". YOLO skips approval checks; a manager can open child windows after it starts. Cancel does not start it.

drawer.noProject: Choose a project before opening the workbench panel.

plan.empty: This project has no briefs yet.
plan.truncated: The file is over 256KB. Only the beginning is shown here.

tasks.empty: No windows to show on the board yet.

runs.capped: Only the last 1MB of the index is shown.

deliver.cancelHint: Cancel only drops the unsent queue. It does not clear an unfinished permission prompt.
deliver.blocked: Waiting on a permission prompt — not sending. If the dialog is already gone, send another line in this window, or close and reopen it.
deliver.permissionHold: After you approve a permission, automatic reminders wait until you send the next message.
deliver.busy: This turn has not finished — not sending
deliver.noNode: No node.exe is available, so turn-complete signals cannot arrive. Use Send now for anything waiting.
deliver.codexManualHint: Send now writes the queued text and one Enter into this terminal. Codex gets no permission signal before the first turn ends. If a confirmation is already on screen, do not press this button.

empty.noProject: No project selected. Create or pick one on the projects page, then open a terminal.
empty.noWindow: This project has no terminal windows yet. Create one to start.

tab.closeConfirmBody: This tab still has running terminals. Closing it will terminate those processes.

modelEffort.confirmBody: Will switch to model {{model}} and effort {{effort}}. The window restarts only after you confirm.

reason.busy: will resume when the window is idle
reason.confirm: waiting for you to confirm resume
reason.not-running: applies on the next manual restart
reason.no-session: cannot resume yet; applies on the next manual restart

limit.reached: Reached the concurrent window limit ({{max}}). Close some windows, or raise the limit in Settings.

projects.empty: No project yet. Pick a directory to create your first one.
projects.loadError: Failed to load the project list
projects.configNotVisible: This config does not exist, or it is limited to specific projects.

card.taskTotal: {{n}} tasks in total (including accepted and cancelled)

create.title: New project

create.configHint: Only configs available to every project are listed. Leave empty to follow the default.

providers.title: Model providers

providers.empty: No provider yet. This is step one: connect a model source first, then you can create profiles.
providers.loadError: Failed to load the provider list

probeStage.unsupported: This type does not support connection testing

cliLogin.noEnumeration: This CLI has no local model enumeration. Leave the model empty to use the CLI default.
cliLogin.modelsEmpty: The model list comes from CLI enumeration (manual entry is disabled). Leave empty to use the CLI default model.
cliLogin.modelHint: Models for local-login come from the CLI: list them via Read local models; leave Profile model empty for CLI default.

listError.unsupported: This CLI does not support local model enumeration
listError.cli_missing: The CLI was not found on PATH. Please make sure it is installed
listError.timeout: Enumeration timed out (the CLI did not respond)
listError.parse_error: Could not parse the CLI output

edit.title: Edit provider
edit.description: Update the source configuration; leave the key blank to keep it.

field.name: Name
field.baseUrlHint: Include the version segment, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1
field.proxyHint: Leave empty to connect directly; format http://host:port (https:// works, socks is not supported). Applies to connection tests and model fetching only.
field.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted in the OS keychain; only the last 4 chars are shown.
field.modelsEmpty: No models yet. Add manually or click "Fetch models".
field.requestTemplateHint: Only for special services incompatible with the standard API formats; for standard OpenAI-compatible services (e.g. DeepSeek), pick the OpenAI-compatible type. The current version does not consume this template at runtime yet.
field.customTypeNotice: The custom type supports neither connection tests nor model fetching.
field.extraEnvHint: One KEY=VALUE per line. Cannot override secret vars; PATH / NODE_OPTIONS / LD_PRELOAD and similar are forbidden.

providers.pickTemplateHint: Pick how you connect, then fill in the endpoint and API key.

anthropic-official.name: Anthropic official
anthropic-official.description: Official Anthropic API key for Claude Code.

anthropic-compatible.name: Anthropic-compatible relay
anthropic-compatible.description: Anthropic-compatible relay; requires a base URL. For Claude Code.

openai-compatible.name: OpenAI-compatible relay
openai-compatible.description: OpenAI-compatible relay; requires a base URL. For Codex (also usable as a Claude Code relay).

local-login.name: Local CLI login
local-login.description: Use the Claude Code / Codex account already logged in on this machine. Injects nothing.

outputLanguage.label: AI output language
outputLanguage.hint: When a Claude or Codex window starts, the chosen language is written into that window's role prompt and it is asked to reply in it. Follow writes nothing. This does not change the CLI's own global settings.
outputLanguage.error: Failed to save AI output language

contextWarn.title: Context threshold reminder
contextWarn.label: Warn threshold
contextWarn.hint: When a session's context usage reaches this share of the model window, the session page suggests a fresh restart.

workbenchLimit.title: Workbench windows
workbenchLimit.label: Concurrent limit
workbenchLimit.hint: Total terminal windows across all projects. New ones are rejected at the limit; the main process enforces it too.

workbenchPermission.title: Workbench permissions
workbenchPermission.label: Default permission for new windows
workbenchPermission.hint: Default level when you create an AI window in the UI. Child windows opened by a window cannot exceed the parent. Not OS isolation on Windows.

workbenchRoles.title: Workbench role briefs
workbenchRoles.hint: Injected when an AI window starts. Edits here are override copies in the app data directory. Reset uses the built-in brief again.

configs.title: Configs
configs.subtitle: Each project uses one config to choose the Claude route and the Codex route. Either route can be left unset.
configs.lastCannotDelete: The last config cannot be deleted
configs.deleteDefaultHint: Choose another config to become the default. Projects that are not bound to a specific config will follow it.
configs.scopeBlocked: These projects are still using this config. Rebind them first: {{names}}
configs.defaultScopeOpen: The default config is available to every project. Its project list cannot be narrowed.
configs.promoteClearsScope: After this becomes the default, every project can use it.

field.name: Name
field.defaultPermissionUnset: Empty — use the global workbench default
field.scopeHint: Leave every box unchecked to allow all projects. If a project outside the list is still bound, the save is rejected.
field.scopeAll: There are no projects yet, so this config is available to all of them.
field.modelHint: Pick from the known list or type a name. Empty = the CLI default.
field.needRoute: Configure at least the Claude route or the Codex route.

profiles.title: Agent profiles
profiles.subtitle: Choose local CLI or a relay URL, then runtime, role and permissions.
profiles.empty: No profile yet. Create one to bind a role and model (requires a provider from the section above).
profiles.loadError: Failed to load the profile list

edit.title: Edit profile
edit.description: Provider reference, model, role and permissions are validated before saving.

field.name: Name
field.connectionModeHint: Local CLI uses this machine's login. Relay uses a URL you configured separately. DeepSeek is relay-only.
field.selectProvider: Select a source with a URL
field.providerRelayHint: Only sources with their own URL are listed. Pick DeepSeek here.
field.providerLocalHint: Uses local CLI login. No URL. Bound automatically on save.
field.modelCliDefaultHint: Leave empty to use the CLI default model (no model argument is passed on dispatch).
field.reasoningEffortHint: Empty = do not pass; follow the CLI or local config. Only an explicit choice is sent.

genericExec.title: Generic command config
genericExec.commandHint: Executable name or absolute path; {task} is not substituted here.
genericExec.deliveryHint: argv substitutes {task} in args; stdin pipes the task text (use for long text).
genericExec.argsHint: One argument per line; argv mode requires a {task} placeholder.

permission.pathsHint: Globs relative to project root, one per line; empty = no access.
permission.dangerousOpsNote: Dangerous ops (delete out of scope, git push, deploy…) always require per-time confirmation and cannot be disabled.
permission.layeringNote: This is an upper bound; each turn's effective scope is the intersection of all layers, further narrowed by the task contract the Planner dispatches.

defaultPermission.title: Default permission preset
defaultPermission.subtitle: The envelope pre-filled when creating a new profile.
defaultPermission.error: Failed to save the default permission preset

knowledgeTool.title: Knowledge search tool (MCP)
knowledgeTool.subtitle: How the agent-facing read-only search tool is launched. Leave blank to use the built-in server — most setups never need to change this.
knowledgeTool.transportNote: The transport is always stdio (a process pipe): no port is opened and no network traffic is produced, so it is unaffected by VPNs, system proxies and firewalls, and it does not disturb your other MCP servers.
knowledgeTool.serverNameHint: MCP server name registered with the agent. Blank uses {{name}}. A server you already have under the same name would collide.
knowledgeTool.commandHint: Blank uses the built-in server. Setting it takes over launching entirely, so provide the arguments too.
knowledgeTool.argsHint: Space separated. Editable only when an executable is set.
knowledgeTool.envHint: One KEY=VALUE per line. The index and audit paths are injected automatically; set them here only to override. Do not put secrets here.

configTool.title: Workbench self-configuration tool
configTool.subtitle: When on, this is registered with manager windows in this project. Nothing is written until you confirm it in the dialog.
configTool.safetyNote: Drafts are not saved on their own. Confirm writes them; cancel discards them. API keys are typed only in the dialog and are never given to the AI.
configTool.label: Enable for the current project
configTool.hint: Applies to project "{{project}}" only. When on, manager windows in this project get the tool. Other roles, and this switch off, do not. Writes need your confirmation.
configTool.enabledNote: On. Manager windows in this project get the tool. Writes need your confirmation.
configTool.needProject: Select a project first — this switch is per-project.

roles.title: Custom roles
roles.subtitle: Roles beyond the built-in Planner/Worker/Reviewer: name + role prompt + permission preset.
roles.empty: No custom roles yet. Create one and bind it in a Profile to use it.

edit.title: Edit role
edit.description: The role prompt is layer 1 of this role's system prompt; the permission preset is its default permission ceiling. Dangerous-operation confirmation cannot be disabled.

field.name: Name
field.systemPromptHint: The role definition sent to the agent verbatim (prompt layer 1; not affected by UI language).

template.label: Start from a template
template.hint: Choosing a template fills name, prompt, and permissions. You can still edit. Switching back to blank clears the form.

memory.searchPlaceholder: Type keywords, or describe the memory in a sentence…
memory.emptyProject: This project has no memory yet. It accrues from sessions and accepted tasks.
memory.sharedPlaceholder: Shared memory (user habits) arrives in Phase 5.

editDialog.title: Edit candidate
editDialog.description: After editing, click "Save and approve" to make it active.

action.page-focus-search: Focus the search box on this page

habit.intro: Habits you have approved and left enabled are written into each Claude or Codex window's role prompt when it starts. Disabled, pending, and deleted habits are left out. Corrections do not create habit candidates.
habit.empty: No shared habits yet. Click “Add habit” to record how you like to work.
habit.nearLimit: {{count}} habits — close to the limit (80). Consider merging or archiving; nothing is auto-evicted.

editDialog.description: Once approved and enabled, this is written into later Claude or Codex windows' role prompts. Phrase it as one general, lasting rule.
editDialog.distillDescription: Turn this project memory into a cross-project habit — strip project-specific details, then confirm.

field.contentHint: One sentence, general and reusable (e.g. “Run existing tests before changes”).
field.distillHint: Remove project names / paths / module names — make it one general, reusable rule.

conflict.description: Found similar existing habits. Replace one, or keep both.

habit.distilled: Distilled to shared memory (see the Shared tab)

observed.toast: You’ve said “{{content}}” {{count}} times — make it a lasting habit?

knowledge.loadError: Failed to load the knowledge base
knowledge.searchPlaceholder: Type keywords or a sentence, then press Enter
knowledge.searchIdle: No search yet. Type keywords or a sentence and press Enter.
knowledge.searchEmpty: No matches. Try different wording, or relax the filters.

recall.likeFallback: Query too short — fell back to substring match
recall.approximate: Too many candidates — semantic results are approximate

blocker.no-provider: No embedding model configured — full-text search only
blocker.spec-mismatch: Embedding model differs from the built index — rebuild the vector index

knowledge.emptySources: The knowledge base is empty. Import a folder to get started.
knowledge.noMatchingSource: No matching source. Try another keyword.
knowledge.sourcesSearchPlaceholder: Filter by title, path, or tag
knowledge.removeDescription: This deletes its chunks, full-text index, and vectors. The original file is untouched and can be imported again.
knowledge.rebuildDescription: Originals are re-read, re-parsed, re-chunked, and re-embedded. Those sources are unsearchable meanwhile, and a remote embedding model will bill for the calls.
knowledge.importDone: Import done: {{indexed}} indexed, {{skipped}} skipped, {{chunks}} chunks, {{embedded}} embedded
knowledge.insertDescription: The selected chunk is added to the composer with its source citation.

agentTool.label: Let the agent search the knowledge base
agentTool.hint: Applies to the current project "{{project}}" only. Off by default.
agentTool.needProject: Select a project on the Projects page first, then decide whether to enable it there.
agentTool.enabledNote: Agents in this project get a read-only search tool. Every query and every hit is recorded in the execution log. Agents cannot write to, modify, or delete the knowledge base.

knowledge.newDescription: The body is stored as Markdown under the knowledge notes directory and stays editable in any editor.
knowledge.captureTitle: Save this message to the knowledge base
knowledge.captureDescription: The captured text becomes searchable, along with a record of which session it came from.

field.title: Title
field.contentHint: Markdown supported; the title is written as a top-level heading.
field.tagsHint: Separate with commas or spaces; used for tag filters in search.
